summary.name: PMAI
summary.one_liner: PMAI is a Chinese-language AI tool that generates high-fidelity UI prototypes from a one-sentence description, with export to Figma or Axure.
use_cases: Turning a feature idea into a clickable prototype quickly
Creating UI mockups without manual design work
Exporting AI-generated screens to Figma or Axure
Sharing or exporting prototypes as HTML
summary.what_it_does: PMAI generates prototype screens from a natural-language description of an interface or feature, producing high-fidelity layouts in a few minutes. Users can adjust details through conversational edits, such as changing a button's color. Finished prototypes can be exported to Figma or Axure, shared online, or exported as HTML. The page also mentions PRD generation among other product-manager features. A user-works gallery and reference-image input are shown as part of the workflow.
notable: One-sentence text-to-prototype generation positioned as an Axure replacement
Conversational real-time editing of generated prototypes
Export to Figma or Axure, plus online sharing and HTML export
caveats: Page advertises free registration; paid tiers are not described on the page
Chinese-language interface; the page does not detail feature limits
